name: checks
description: Repo guardrails as scripts behind a gate — one script per check with a stable id and exit codes 0 / 1 / 2 meaning pass, findings, refused; .claude/checks.json names the enabled checks and each one's rung, warn or block; a git pre-commit adapter judges the index and is inert in a repo with no config. Two checks ship: anchors (every in-repo section link resolves to an explicit <a id> and every relative link target exists) and war-stories (narrative provenance in process docs). Rung as config is the enforcement ladder made add-only.
